posts.caption:
Meet ZARI.

We are building a house of hand-knotted rugs rooted in Indian craftsmanship and made for timeless homes.

The first collection is still taking shape. Follow @zarirugs to see the decisions, materials and hands behind its making.

#ZariRugs #IndianCraft #HandKnottedRugs #TimelessInteriors

A rug begins one row at a time.

Before a pattern can be seen, the structure must be built: warp held in tension, wool placed by hand, each decision repeated until an image appears.

#ZariRugs #RugWeaving #MadeByHand #TextileCraft

A room changes when the floor has a point of view.

Pattern anchors the space, while daylight changes its tone through the day. This is the atmosphere guiding ZARI's first collection.

#ZariRugs #RugInterior #TimelessInteriors #InteriorDesignIndia

Before colour, choose scale.

In a living room, the rug should hold the conversation area together. Let at least the front legs of the sofa and chairs meet it; if every piece floats outside, the rug is usually too small.

Save this rule before you measure your room.

#ZariRugs #RugGuide #InteriorDesign #ConsideredHomes

A rug should make sense to the hand as well as the eye.

Look closely at the weave, the density and the edge. These details reveal how the surface will feel, how the pattern is built and how the rug may age.

Which matters more to you first: texture or colour?

#ZariRugs #RugDetails #TextileDesign #MaterialStudy

Let one pattern lead the room.

When the rug carries the strongest motif, quieter furniture gives it space to work. Natural light then changes the contrast from morning to evening without adding more objects.

Would you choose the rug first or last?

#ZariRugs #RugStyling #InteriorDesign #PatternAtHome

A room does not begin at the walls. It begins underfoot—where colour, movement, and memory meet. ZARI.

#ZariRugs #InteriorFilm #RugDesign #TimelessInteriors
